title.zh: 微软取消与英国数据中心商Nscale的AI合作，后者上市计划承压
title.en: 微软取消与英国数据中心商Nscale的AI合作，后者上市计划承压

current_state.zh: Microsoft has withdrawn from its AI data center agreement with Nscale in Essex, dealing a major blow to the UK AI infrastructure project and Nscale's planned US IPO.
